mentions.name: thingstohave.app
mentions.description: A quirky wishlist app for tracking things you want, featuring image loading from blur, unadvertised but advanced drag-and-drop everywhere, natural language currency inputs with sorting, and a platform-agnostic quick add. Built on the Cloudflare Workers ecosystem with a custom Inertia.js adapter for Hono and Vue SSR, using an old-school MVC approach with Vue as the template engine; cheap to run and finished ahead of public launch.
mentions.source_excerpt: My quirky wishlist app https://thingstohave.app is finally done and heading to public launch this or next week.

mentions.name: Things to Have
mentions.description: This app is a flexible and social wishlist app. Users organize wishlist things into lists, with a redesigned list view layout and a gallery view under testing. Things support image attachments, with pixel bomb detection, image optimization, and self-hosted imgproxy used for price-efficient image processing since Cloudflare Workers don't support sharp. The app also received many quality-of-life features and bugfixes and is close to feature-complete for V1.
mentions.problem: Users were confused by an annoying pattern where they mixed up lists and things, which was fixed by changing how lists appear in the UI.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm continuing my work on https://thingstohave.app – a flexible and social wishlist app.

mentions.description: This social wishlist app lets people create and share lists of things they want. Recent work adds image uploading, passkeys, and a clearer list organization UI, and the app was migrated from SvelteKit to a Hono + Inertia + Vue architecture with Storybook-exposed UI states.
